title: The Winter War: Soviet Divisions Swallowed by the Snow
summary: Recounts the Soviet Union's attack on Finland on the thirtieth of November, nineteen thirty-nine, and the resistance put up for one hundred and five days by a country fifty times smaller in population. The episode ranges from the Soviet divisions torn apart in the snow at Suomussalmi and on the Raate Road to the Moscow Peace, and to the way the weakness displayed by the Red Army emboldened Hitler toward Barbarossa.
